sites.name: Con Dao Prison
sites.event: Known as 'Hell on Earth' during the French and American periods, this was where tens of thousands of revolutionary soldiers and patriots were imprisoned and exiled.

sites.name: Hang Duong Cemetery
sites.event: The resting place of tens of thousands of revolutionary soldiers and patriots, including the grave of heroine Vo Thi Sau.

sites.name: Bach Dinh (Villa Blanche)
sites.event: A European-style mansion built in 1898, which once served as a retreat for the Governor-General of French Indochina and King Bao Dai, and as a place of house arrest for King Thanh Thai.

sites.name: Christ the King Statue (The Outstretched Arms Christ Statue)
sites.event: A symbol of Vung Tau City, it is the largest statue of Jesus Christ in Asia (record established in 2012).

sites.name: Minh Dam Base Area
sites.event: An important revolutionary base of Ba Ria - Long Khanh Province during the two resistance wars against the French and Americans, utilizing the rugged mountainous terrain.

place.commune: Phuoc Hai Town, Tam Phuoc Commune, Phuoc Hung Commune...
place.district: Dat Do District, Long Dien District

sites.name: Long Phuoc Tunnels
sites.event: A large-scale tunnel system dug by the military and people of Long Phuoc Commune starting in 1948 to serve in combat.

sites.name: Long Son Large House (Ong Tran Temple)
sites.event: An ancient architectural and artistic complex, the birthplace of the Ong Tran belief system, which preserves the traditional lifestyle of the Southern region.

sites.name: Vung Tau Lighthouse
sites.event: Built by the French in 1862, it is one of the oldest lighthouses in Vietnam.

sites.name: Back Beach (Thuy Van Beach)
sites.event: The longest and most famous beach in Vung Tau.

sites.name: Ho Tram
sites.event: An unspoiled beach area with luxury resorts, located between Binh Chau and Long Hai.

sites.name: Nghinh Phong Cape
sites.event: A cape stretching out into the sea with a unique shape, welcoming the wind all four seasons (meaning 'welcoming the wind').
